died.name: Polycarp
died.cause: prior to martyrdom by burning and spearing
died.last_words: O Lord God Almighty, Father of Thy well-beloved Son, Jesus Christ, by whom we have received knowledge of Thee; God of angels, powers, and every creature that lives before Thee; I thank Thee that Thou hast graciously thought me worthy of this day and hour, that I may receive a portion in the number of Thy martyrs, and drink of Christ's cup, for the resurrection of both soul and body unto life eternal, in the incorruptibleness of the Holy Spirit. Among them may I be admitted this day, as an acceptable sacrifice, as Thou, O true and faithful God, hast prepared, foreshown, and accomplished. Wherefore, I praise Thee for all Thy mercies. I bless Thee. I glorify Thee, with Jesus Christ, Thy beloved Son, the Eternal, to Whom, with Thee and the Holy Spirit, be glory now and forever.

died.name: Stanisław Leszczyński
died.cause: The duke of Lorraine and former king of Poland died from wounds after his silk attire had caught fire from a spark while he was sitting near the fireplace in his Château de Lunéville.

died.name: Joshua Reynolds
died.last_words: I have been fortunate in long good health and constant success, and I ought not to complain. I know that all things on earth must have an end, and now I am come to mine.

died.name: John Keats
died.last_words: I can feel the daisies growing over me.

died.name: John Quincy Adams
died.cause: after collapsing in the United States Capitol
died.last_words: This is the last of Earth. I am content.

died.name: Paul Claudel
died.last_words: Doctor, do you think it could have been the sausage?
